content_zh:
第九章黄色书？
没走几步，叶宇轩便在一颗大树下面看到了另外一个半兽人勇士。．根据观察少女和半兽人勇士之间激烈的战斗。叶宇轩知道虽然半兽人勇士变强了。
但是他的本质还没有变化，也就是说，他的攻击和防御甚至是生命都得到了大幅度的提升，但是他的速度，不管是移动速度还是攻击速度变化都不大。
因此叶宇轩对于对付这种家伙，直接是信心满满，胸有成竹。有心与半兽人勇士比拼一下力量的叶宇轩，主动迎上，紧握乌木剑的双臂，卯足了力量。向着半兽人勇士的头颅砍去。
另一边，看到身体虽然瘦小，但是气势十足，来势汹汹的叶宇轩，半兽人勇士也不敢有丝毫的怠慢，猛烈的挥舞着铁棒，迎上叶宇轩的乌木剑。
“砰”地一声，一剑一棒相交，顿时叶宇轩感觉到一股巨力从双手上传入身体。两臂疼痛异常，感觉折断一般，但这半兽人勇士也不好过，虎口崩裂，丝丝鲜血顺着两只大手，落于地面。铁棒几乎脱手飞出，一张粗犷的脸上露出一丝震惊和惶恐。
看到半兽人勇士好像被自己的勇武所吓着，呆呆的站在那里。作为军人的叶宇轩最会的就是把握机会。强忍住双臂的钻心疼痛。疯狂的挥舞着乌木剑对着半兽人勇士砍杀。
“卟”地一声，半兽人勇士在叶宇轩疯狂的砍杀中，嘴里发出低微的惨嚎，脑袋崩裂倒飞出来，一滩物品爆在了地面。
快速的捡起地上的物品放入自己的空间中，急速后退，寻找了一个高树做了上去，
效果果然明显，大约一分钟的时间，原本疼痛的叶宇轩额头滴滴汗水下流的胳膊，已经变的完好无损。
回想起自己此次的战斗，叶宇轩不禁暗骂一声：“白痴。”如果不是自己心血**，没事找事做的找他正面对决，凭借着自己灵敏的身手，采用迂回战术，又怎么会受伤，浪费一瓶金疮药。
体力20，力量25，增加防御3－3，附加：体力+1。可兑换1200点积分。
好啊，叶宇轩看到这件装备的属性，情不自禁的喊了出来。要知道东西是有所比较的，和叶宇轩现在的布衣相比，这件铠甲不知要好多少。
看到自己的属性刚刚够，暗暗抚摸了一下自己紧张的心。
迫不及待的穿上这件装备，看着在太阳的照射下闪闪发光的鳞羽。叶宇轩满心的喜悦，带上它以后自己的生命将会更加有保证。
喜悦的心情平静下来之后，叶宇轩知道自己的任务还没有结束，还有一个半兽人勇士没有干掉。
从树干上轻轻跳下，再次走向刷新半兽人勇士之地。没走多远叶宇轩再次看到一个半兽人勇士，叶宇轩不禁感叹，这里果然是半兽人勇士群集之地。
有过一次经验的叶宇轩，不急不缓的走上前去。刚走到半兽人勇士面前。一个巨大的铁棒夹杂着呼呼的风劲向着叶宇轩英俊的脑袋砸去，顿时一股极大的危险感出现在叶宇轩的心底，条件发射一般，双腿一蹬，向后方跳起。
“咚，”地上平整的土地掀起了高高的尘土。，惊险的躲过着当头一棒。
想到自己的脑袋就差那么零点几秒就和那粗壮的铁棒来了个亲密接触。一想到那样的后果，叶宇轩额头上的汗水不自觉的随着脸颊缓缓留下。

再一次经历了生死瞬间的叶宇轩，心智又成熟了几分，完全收起自己的骄傲之心，开始认真对待起眼前的家伙。
不敢在有丝毫大意，脚尖点地，迅速迎了上去，如出一辙，铁棒再次重重麾下，虽然半兽人勇士使出了全身力量使得铁棒带着惯性的作用，攻击速度变快。
但早有防备的叶宇轩，依旧凭借着自身灵魂的身躯，微微侧身闪开。
“咚，”平整的土地上再次出现一块土坑，接着是飞扬的尘土。而半兽人勇士也因为这下用力过猛，身体未能完美的平衡，出现了短暂的倾斜。
看到半兽人勇士此时的姿势，叶宇轩立即意识到这是一个绝好的机会。双脚快速移动，眨眼之间已经闪到他的后方，举起散发着黑光的乌木剑对着半兽人勇士弓起的腰板狠狠的砸下。
“砰，”，腰与剑刚刚接触，“咔嚓，”叶宇轩变听到一声清脆的响声。同时铁棒撑地倾斜着身体的半兽人勇士，毫无防备的被身后一股巨大的冲击力撞倒在地。
“咚，”又是一声巨响随着半兽人勇士倒地传了出来。乘胜追击是叶宇轩的最爱，不再给半兽人勇士任何的机会，乌木剑一击一击的疯狂砸下。
就这样，强大的半兽人勇士冤屈的死了，留给了叶宇轩一滩黄金和一本黄色封面的书籍。
人勇士2/2。主线任务一：完成。
看到最后两个字，叶宇轩一阵激动，一股莫名的成就感出现在他的心中。缓缓平复下心中的喜悦，捡起地上的黄金，仔细一看有三百两，也就是300点积分。让叶宇轩不禁感觉混积分也不是太难的。
看着最后一本黄色书籍，叶宇轩一阵疑惑，难道半兽人勇士也和人类一样，喜欢这种东西。那里面的画面将是什么，两个半兽人之间.....
想到这里一股恶心的感觉涌上心头。不会的，不会的，叶宇轩心中默念了两边，双手颤抖的

“哇不错啊，”叶宇轩一阵感叹，虽然只是最垃圾的D级技能但是可以如果在战斗中出其不意的使用，让人防不胜防，另外如果击中之后出现灼烧，将影响对方的实力。使自己的胜算更大。【学校可以上网了，明天回复更新，每天两到三章的样子】

After walking a few steps, Ye Yuxuan saw another Orc warrior under a big tree. ． Observe the fierce battle between the girl and the orc warrior. Ye Yuxuan knew that although the orc warriors had become stronger.
But his essence has not changed, that is to say, his attack, defense and even life have been greatly improved, but his speed, whether it is movement speed or attack speed, has not changed much.
Therefore, Ye Yuxuan is confident and confident in dealing with this kind of guy. Ye Yuxuan, who was determined to compete with the orc warriors for strength, took the initiative to meet him, grasping the ebony sword in both arms and exerting all his strength. Cut off the head of the orc warrior.
On the other side, seeing Ye Yuxuan who was thin but powerful and menacing, the half-orc warrior did not dare to show any signs of neglect and fiercely waved the iron rod to meet Ye Yuxuan's ebony sword.
With a "bang" sound, one sword and one stick collided, and Ye Yuxuan suddenly felt a huge force entering his body from his hands. Both arms were in extreme pain and felt like they were broken, but the half-orc warrior didn't fare well either. The tiger's mouth burst open, and traces of blood flowed down his two big hands and fell to the ground. The iron rod almost flew out of his hand, and a trace of shock and fear appeared on his rough face.
Seeing that the orc warrior seemed to be frightened by his own bravery, he stood there blankly. As a soldier, what Ye Yuxuan knows best is to seize opportunities. He endured the excruciating pain in his arms. Frantically waving the ebony sword to slash at the orc warriors.
With a "porphy" sound, the half-orc warrior let out a low howl in Ye Yuxuan's crazy slashing, his head cracked and flew out, and a pool of items exploded on the ground.
He quickly picked up the items on the ground and put them into his own space. He quickly retreated and found a tall tree to climb up.
The effect was indeed obvious. In about a minute, Ye Yuxuan's arm, which was originally in pain and dripping with sweat from his forehead, became completely intact.
Recalling his own battle this time, Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but secretly cursed: "Idiot." If he hadn't worked so hard to find something to do, he had nothing to do to confront him head-on, relying on his agile skills and using roundabout tactics, how could he have been injured and wasted a bottle of golden sore medicine.
Physical strength 20, strength 25, defense increased by 3-3, additional: physical strength +1. Can be redeemed for 1,200 points.
Okay, Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but shout out when he saw the properties of this piece of equipment. You must know that things are compared. Compared with Ye Yuxuan's current common clothes, this armor is much better.
Seeing that his attributes were just enough, he secretly stroked his nervous heart.
I can't wait to put on this equipment and look at the scales and feathers shining in the sun. Ye Yuxuan is filled with joy. His life will be more secure after wearing it.
After the joyful mood calmed down, Ye Yuxuan knew that his mission was not over yet, and there was still an orc warrior who had not yet been killed.
Jump gently from the tree trunk and walk towards the place where the Orc warriors are refreshed again. Not far away, Ye Yuxuan saw a half-orc warrior again. Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but sigh, this is indeed a place where half-orc warriors gather.
Ye Yuxuan, who had had the experience before, walked forward unhurriedly. Just walked up to the Orc Warrior. A huge iron rod mixed with the whistling wind hit Ye Yuxuan's handsome head. Suddenly, a great sense of danger appeared in Ye Yuxuan's heart. As if he was ready to launch, he kicked his legs and jumped back.
"Boom," the flat land on the ground stirred up high dust. , narrowly dodging a blow to the head.
Thinking that his head was only a few tenths of a second away from coming into close contact with that thick iron rod. Thinking of the consequences of that, the sweat on Ye Yuxuan's forehead slowly slowly followed his cheeks.
Ye Yuxuan, who once again experienced the moment of life and death, has become more mentally mature.He completely put away his pride and began to take the guy in front of him seriously.
Not daring to be careless at all, he tiptoed to the ground and quickly faced him. Just like the same, the iron rod hit him hard again. Although the half-orc warrior used all his strength, the iron rod had the effect of inertia, and the attack speed became faster.
But Ye Yuxuan, who had been on guard for a long time, still relied on his soul body to dodge slightly.
"Boom," a pit appeared again on the flat land, followed by flying dust. The half-orc warrior also used too much force and his body was not perfectly balanced, causing him to tilt briefly.
Seeing the posture of the orc warrior at this time, Ye Yuxuan immediately realized that this was an excellent opportunity. His feet moved quickly, and he had already flashed behind him in the blink of an eye. He raised the ebony sword emitting black light and struck it hard against the arched waist of the orc warrior.
"Bang," as soon as his waist and sword came into contact, "click," Ye Yuxuan suddenly heard a crisp sound. At the same time, the orc warrior, who was leaning on the ground with an iron bar, was unprepared and knocked to the ground by a huge impact force from behind.
"Boom," another loud noise came out as the Orc warrior fell to the ground. Pursuing victory is Ye Yuxuan's favorite. He no longer gives the Orc warrior any chance, and hits the ebony sword crazily one blow after another.
In this way, the powerful orc warrior died unjustly, leaving Ye Yuxuan with a pool of gold and a book with a yellow cover.
Human Warrior 2/2. Main mission one: completed.
Seeing the last two words, Ye Yuxuan was excited, and an inexplicable sense of accomplishment appeared in his heart. Slowly calming down the joy in my heart, I picked up the gold on the ground and took a closer look. There were three hundred taels, which was 300 points. Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but feel that it was not too difficult to get points.
Looking at the last pornographic book, Ye Yuxuan wondered for a while whether orc warriors also liked this kind of thing like humans. What will be the scene inside, between two orcs...
Thinking of this, a sick feeling came to my heart. No, no, Ye Yuxuan thought silently in his heart, his hands trembling.
